text: Phone navigation follows the template: status bar and camera island appear in the preview only, never in the app; no top bar on phone; one bottom bar on every screen (Shelf, Path, Bible, Topics, Review, Search, You). Lesson and Bible are focus screens with a close button; the lesson shows 'Step x of y' plus a chain of dots; the Shelf's selected book docks above the bar. Chris may veto after seeing it.
